description: This file contains CMake functions and scripts for configuring header-only libraries and packages, generating configuration files, and managing dependencies within a CMake-based build system.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Installs and configures a header-only library by generating CMake config files, handling target dependencies, and setting up installation directives.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Generates and installs a pkg-config style configuration file for a header-only library, including compile options, include dirs, and link libraries.
